scope: compared with X_ITE 16.6.0 step for step: typing, Backspace (also on an empty string and with deletionAllowed false), Enter, Escape, Tab, a typed string with a space, shifted letters

IME and dead-key composition are not handled by either engine: both read keydown only (X_ITE 16.6.0 KeyDeviceSensorComponent registers keydown and keyup), so a composed character arrives only if the browser also reports it as a key
